falseSynonyms.zh: 夏令營不等於 boot camp summer camp 通常以休閒、教育、社交或戶外活動為主；boot camp 則強調密集訓練、快速技能發展或嚴格紀律。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A summer camp may be educational or recreational, while a boot camp is usually intensive and training-focused.

falseSynonyms.zh: 一般工作坊不一定是 boot camp workshop 可以只有一兩小時；boot camp 通常更密集、更長或要求更高。只有 intensive workshop 才可能在部分語境接近。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A short workshop is not automatically a boot camp; intensity and duration matter.

falseSynonyms.zh: 一般課程過於寬泛 course 可以持續數月甚至數年，也可以每週只上一課；boot camp 通常短期、密集、集中。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Every boot camp may function as a course, but most courses are not boot camps.

falseSynonyms.zh: 營地／營會過於寬泛 camp 可以是露營、夏令營、宗教營或休閒營；boot camp 有明確訓練或紀律目的。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Camp is a broad category; boot camp adds intensive training or discipline.

falseSynonyms.zh: 研討會不等於密集訓練營 seminar 以講解、討論或學術交流為主，通常不含 boot camp 的高密度實作訓練。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A seminar is discussion- or lecture-oriented; a boot camp is usually practice-intensive.

falseSynonyms.zh: 靜修／退修活動不等於 boot camp retreat 常強調休息、反思、團隊交流或遠離日常環境，不一定是高強度訓練。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A retreat may be reflective or restorative rather than intensive.

falseSynonyms.zh: 迎新／簡介不等於 boot camp orientation 主要幫助新成員了解環境、規則和程序；boot camp 則訓練技能或體能。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Orientation introduces people to a setting; boot camp trains them intensively.

falseSynonyms.zh: 實習不等於密集訓練課程 internship 是在真實工作環境中累積經驗，通常持續較長時間；boot camp 是集中式培訓。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON An internship provides workplace experience; a boot camp provides concentrated training.
